Name: Sallu, Son of Meshullam
Summary: Son of Meshullam son of Hodaviah son of Hasenuah, of the sons of Benjamin dwelling in Jerusalem.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 9:7: Son of Meshullam son of Hodaviah son of Hasenuah, of the sons of Benjamin dwelling in Jerusalem.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Sallu stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
